name: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co
moat_justification: Scale and hard-to-replicate origination/logistics/crush infrastructure and segment diversification, against no pricing power (price-taker on inputs and outputs), crush/ethanol margins set by commodity markets and EPA RVO policy (the entire 2026 earnings rebound is policy-driven), through-cycle ROIC in the high single digits (7.8% adjusted ROIC TTM at a cyclical upswing), and equally scaled undifferentiated rivals (Bunge, Cargill, COFCO).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 4.9%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 8.51 vs 3-yr median 5.27 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
one_liner: Enduring commodity processor with scale/logistics advantages but no pricing power, moat 4/10 — at $83.20, after the RVO-driven guidance raise was priced in, it yields an 8.9% weighted IRR with IV@15% of $42.39; it clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$42, and even the super-bull case stays below today's price.
moat_for: Global origination, storage and transportation network at hard-to-replicate scale
Diversified footprint across oilseeds, corn processing and Nutrition
Equity earnings from unconsolidated affiliates incl. Wilmar ($648M FY2025)
Balance-sheet staying power through cycles (378 consecutive dividend quarters)
moat_against: Commodity price-taker: crush/ethanol margins are market-set, no pricing power
Earnings hostage to US biofuel policy (EPA renewable volume obligations)
Nutrition growth story damaged by the intersegment-accounting restatement/SEC settlement
Working-capital-heavy model absorbs cash when commodity prices rise; thin structural margins
